tasks.subject: Blocking first steps: settle the intermediate container shape
tasks.description:
Gate before any code: decide FLV-renamed vs live ffmpeg pipe to TS vs HLS byte-copy. Evidence in hand: FLV magic is `FLV\x01\x05`; killed-mid-write TS probes as mpegts duration 4.379s with both codecs and remuxes to a clean 4.16s mp4; truncated FLV reports duration 0.000000. Architect design pass running (agent a88a921d). Design decision recorded in .crew/spec.md.</description>

tasks.subject: Smallest safe decomposition: one owner for the whole capture path
tasks.description:
One worker owns it: the ffmpeg lifecycle, the stdin-close cancellation contract, and the Convert rename are one interlocking contract — splitting them across agents would leave the cancel semantics unverified in each half. Single owner, reviewed diff.</description>
<parameter name="activeForm">Choosing the decomposition

tasks.subject: Implement TS intermediate + remux, delegated to one owner
tasks.description:
Implement: capture goes through ffmpeg to a .ts intermediate; remux .ts -> .mp4 at end or on cancel. Must cover: stdin-close unblocks a stalled write (body.Close alone does not), EPIPE mid-capture is not fatal (TS on disk stays valid), ffmpeg failing to start falls back to raw capture so data is never lost, per-candidate ffmpeg restart, Convert renamed from _flv.mp4 to .ts. Files: internal/record/recorder.go, internal/record/ffmpeg.go, plus recorder_test.go/ffmpeg_test.go.</description>
<parameter name="activeForm">Implementing the TS capture path

tasks.subject: Verify live: clean mp4 at end, playable ts on kill
tasks.description:
Verify on the real surface: go build/vet/test -race green, then a live 5s capture with tmux Ctrl-C mid-run producing a playable .mp4 (ffprobe duration, both streams), plus a SIGKILL mid-capture leaving a playable .ts. Wrong-surface or inconclusive is not a pass.</description>
<parameter name="activeForm">Verifying live capture and cancel paths
